description: Runs in de-llm, mirrored here. Essay- and report-scale re-imagining: diagnose the architecture, imagine rivals, let the author choose from a memo, regenerate section by section, audit cold, repair, finalize. The loop is fractal; the memo is the choice screen rendered as a document.

phases.phase_description: Any file to canonical Markdown, block tree, heading tree, section partition.
Summary, crux, contract, strands, genre; the twelve elements the document runs on.
One McPhee card per section; the manuscript's own conventions.
Diagnosis, trial leads, three to five candidate skeletons, ranked under the author's ambition.
The Restructuring Memo as a letter; the author chooses a shape (zero calls).
One directive per section; signed removals adopted or rejected explicitly (zero calls).
Desk rules chosen; strands drafted whole; sections written in the new order; frames; retitle.
Document assembled; mechanical screens; coherence, skeleton, strand, drift, deep-structure, independent reader, stance placement.
Bounded per-section repairs, re-audit, loop until clean.
Final document and the closing memo: what the article now runs on.

output_description: A restructured document (md, docx, pdf), the memos, the audit record, and per-finding resolutions.
